findings.claim: R1-03 remains partially unresolved: undo silently preserves the first contact added to a legacy contactless lead.
findings.evidence: Edit a lead whose contacts are null, add a phone, save, then click Desfazer. leadToWriteSeed examines the previous state and omits both contact keys. The API preserves omitted keys at lead-service.ts:1161-1162, so undo succeeds while retaining the added phone. In-memory evaluation of the actual function confirmed previousContact:null, inverseHasContactPhone:false, contactAfterUndo:"11999999999". The new regression test covers only edits that remain contactless.
findings.suggestion: Keep omission for edits that remain contactless. Suppress the undo offer when an edit introduces the first contact unless a complete inverse is supported. Cover this scenario explicitly.
